entities.summary: Dmytro Mykolaiovych Tolkunov is a Ukrainian ice hockey defender who competed at the 2002 Winter Olympics and at the 2002, 2004, 2005, 2009 and 2010 world championships. He played for Ukrainian, Russian, Belarusian, Hungarian, Canadian and American clubs, and won the Ukrainian national title in 2011, 2012 and 2015.
